dvbackpack.tooltip.use: Right-click: open · Sneak + right-click the ground: set down · Worn: B
dvbackpack.deposit: Put everything from the inventory in (not the hotbar)
dvbackpack.upgrade.crafting.desc: A crafting grid beside the backpack.
dvbackpack.upgrade.smoker.desc: Cooks food twice as fast, wherever the backpack is.
dvbackpack.upgrade.blast_furnace.desc: Smelts ores and metal twice as fast, wherever the backpack is.
dvbackpack.upgrade_slot: Upgrade slot: put an upgrade card here
dvbackpack.upgrade.pickup.desc: Items you pick up go into the backpack. Its magnet pulls them to you.
dvbackpack.upgrade.void.desc: Items on its list are destroyed when you pick them up.
dvbackpack.upgrade.feeding.desc: Eats food from the backpack when you are hungry.
dvbackpack.upgrade.refill.desc: When the stack in your hand runs out, brings more from the backpack.
dvbackpack.filter.only.tooltip: Only the items on the list. Click: everything except them
dvbackpack.filter.except.tooltip: Everything except the items on the list. Click: only them
dvbackpack.magnet.tooltip: Pulls items within 6 blocks to you
dvbackpack.tank.hint: Click with a bucket or bottle: fill or empty
dvbackpack.sleeping_bag: Lay out / roll up the sleeping bag
dvbackpack.sleeping_bag.no_room: No room for the sleeping bag in front of the backpack
dvbackpack.sleep_now: Lay out the sleeping bag and sleep
dvbackpack.sleeping_bag.no_room_ahead: No room for the sleeping bag in front of you
